messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then raises both arms overhead and swings them in a rhythmic, dance-like motion before lowering them back to her sides.","camera":"A static, full-body shot from a slightly elevated angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short white dress with a pink and green floral pattern, off-the-shoulder sleeves, and a V-neckline, paired with pink lace-up sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short blue hair with straight bangs and a small low ponytail at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with dark skin, a slim build, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor industrial or construction area with a cracked concrete floor, scattered wooden pallets, a large rusted pipe, and a dark building entrance in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is now a full-body, slightly elevated front three-quarter view of the character, matching the reference framing. The character's floral dress, blue hair, and dance-like arm-raising motion are retained, but the original seaside background has been replaced by an industrial/construction area with wooden pallets, a rusted pipe, and a dark building entrance.
arguments.requested_change: Switch only the camera to a high-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view, using the reference for initial framing while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, timing, and existing scene.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial expression was fully preserved.
unexpected_changes: The existing scene was changed from a seaside pier to an industrial/construction area.
The character's hairstyle changed from a back bun to short blue hair with bangs and a small low ponytail.
The character's shoes became visible as pink lace-up sneakers, which were not visible in the source framing.
